description: List or keyword-search the Copernicus Climate Data Store catalogue — the ~140 published climate datasets (ERA5 reanalysis, CMIP6/CORDEX projections, satellite ECVs, seasonal forecasts, in-situ networks). Returns each collection id (pass it to cds_collection or cds_submit_request), title, and the temporal/spatial extent it covers. Keyless. AUTHORITATIVE for "which Copernicus/C3S dataset covers X" — the catalogue itself, not a description of it.

query.description: Optional keyword filter, matched against collection id, title and description (e.g. "sea ice", "ERA5", "wildfire"). Omit to list everything.

name: cds_collections
title: Cds Collections
